summary: How the Crew opens the host connection, and what the relay reads from it.

provisional.why: Per-stage settings. kiro-relay under on.aws and api.aws was chosen on 10/25 for now, pending the naming review. Beta and gamma start on other names.
Open: whether a Bearer host token is acceptable on an api.aws name, since the AWS naming standard points service APIs at SigV4. Not decided.

planPosition: A failed host token at the upgrade gets the plain 401 rather than an upgrade and a 4401 close, so unauthenticated callers never hold a socket.
rule: The Crew dials the hostUrl from its lease answer with Authorization: Bearer and its host token. The host dial name is not a Crew's host name. The relay takes the endpoint from the host token's ep claim, never from the Host header. A token that fails gets the plain 401 and no upgrade.

cases.name: upgrade
cases.expect: 101, then the Crew sends hello within 10 seconds
